title: Nay's Enhanced Ender
description: An Ender heavy focused Modpack made for Fabric 1.20.1
body:
Nay's Enhanced Ender is a modpack fully based arround upgrading the whole ender experience.

It is the Fifth Modpack of the "Nay's Enhanced" Series.

It mainly focuses on adding more biomes and stuctures to the whole dimension to improve it.

The main goal is to make the Ender Experience feel fresher and newer for experienced players as well as adding more difficulty to the end access to further expend the longevity of minecraft

It also adds other content to improve vanilla but those are more Quality of Life mods than full on add-ons to the modpack.
